create_AtomicFactGenerator: create an AtomicFactGenerator instance with an API key and optional language model for atomic fact extraction
run_AtomicFactGenerator: run the AtomicFactGenerator to convert a text generation into a set of atomic facts with paragraph breaks
get_atomic_facts_from_paragraph: get atomic facts from a list of paragraphs using NLTK sentence tokenization and BM25 demo matching
postprocess_atomic_facts: postprocess atomic facts by merging short sentences, detecting entities, and filtering redundant facts
fix_sentence_splitter: fix NLTK sentence splitter issues by merging sentences split on initials or lowercase continuations
